definitions.gloss: unauthorized reproduction; unauthorized reposting; reprinting without permission
definitions.explanation: Copying and republishing someone else's content (text, images, videos, etc.) without obtaining their permission. Extremely common on Japanese websites as a warning against unauthorized sharing.

examples.japanese: {無断転載|むだんてんさい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無断転載|むだんてんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from reposting this photo without permission.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無断転載|むだんてんさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}{侵害|しんがい}→著作権侵害：25454_chosakukenshingai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訴|うった}えられた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: Unauthorized reposting on social media became a problem, and a copyright infringement lawsuit was filed.

notes: Composed of ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧ (without permission) + ⟦{転載|てんさい}→転載：14359_tensai⟧ (reprinting, reposting). One of the most common copyright-related phrases seen on Japanese websites, blogs, and social media. Almost always appears as {無断転載|むだんてんさい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (unauthorized reproduction prohibited) or {無断転載|むだんてんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please refrain from unauthorized reproduction). Related: ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ (unauthorized use), ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦{複製|ふくせい}→複製：17528_fukusei⟧ (unauthorized copying).
